scope: Header only; no proof validity or source acceptance claim

binders_in_order.name: hbot
binders_in_order.type: ∀ i < n + 1, ∀ x, loss i x ≠ ⊥

binders_in_order.name: hstrong
binders_in_order.type: let G : E → EReal := fun x => (psi x : EReal) + ∑ i ∈ range (n + 1), loss i x + extendedIndicator V x; ∀ x ∈ V, ∀ y ∈ V, ∀ a : ℝ, 0 < a → a < 1 → G (a • x + (1 - a) • y) ≤ (a : EReal) * G x + ((1 - a : ℝ) : EReal) * G y - (((lam / 2) * a * (1 - a) * ‖x - y‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : EReal)

binders_in_order.name: hprediction
binders_in_order.type: IsMinOn (fun x => (psi x : EReal) + ∑ i ∈ range n, loss i x + (hint x : EReal)) V p

binders_in_order.name: hdifference
binders_in_order.type: ∀ z ∈ V, (loss n p).toReal - hint p + g (z - p) ≤ (loss n z).toReal - hint z

local_objective.definition: fun x => (psi x : EReal) + ∑ i ∈ range (n + 1), loss i x + extendedIndicator V x

prediction_objective.definition: fun x => (psi x : EReal) + ∑ i ∈ range n, loss i x + (hint x : EReal)

quantifier_scopes.hbot: ∀ i : ℕ, i < n+1 → ∀ x : E, loss i x ≠ bottom; global in x
quantifier_scopes.hdom: ∀ i : ℕ, i < n+1 → ∀ x : E, x ∈ V → loss i x < top
quantifier_scopes.hstrong: ∀ x : E, x ∈ V → ∀ y : E, y ∈ V → ∀ a : ℝ, 0 < a → a < 1 → displayed EReal inequality
quantifier_scopes.hprediction: ∀ z : E, z ∈ V → prediction(p) ≤ prediction(z)
quantifier_scopes.hdifference: ∀ z : E, z ∈ V → displayed real affine-support inequality
quantifier_scopes.q: arbitrary feasible comparator; no minimizer assumption

norms.hstrong: given ambient E norm of x-y, squared
norms.conclusion: operator norm of continuous real linear functional g, squared

conclusion.expression: let G := actualG; (G p).toReal - (G q).toReal ≤ ‖g‖ ^ 2 / (2 * lam)
conclusion.direction: upper bound on signed objective gap

finiteness.toReal_hazard: Both EReal infinities map to zero; unrestricted order/arithmetic preservation cannot be presumed
finiteness.loss_on_V: hbot and hdom imply finite loss i x for all i ≤ n and x ∈ V
finiteness.objectives_on_V: finite real-valued terms plus finite EReal losses; indicator zero
finiteness.evaluations: p, q and quantified z are feasible, so every toReal occurrence is applied to a finite value
finiteness.strong_combination: hV and 0<a<1 make the convex-combination point feasible
finiteness.outside_V: No upper-finiteness hypothesis on loss; no cancellation with infinities is asserted

edge_cases.empty_V: Universal convexity/support clauses may be vacuous, but hp and hq cannot be supplied; full premises entail nonempty V
edge_cases.n_zero: permitted; prediction is psi+hint and actualG includes loss 0

not_asserted_or_assumed: Existence or construction of p, q or g
Differentiability or gradient identification of g
Convexity or strong convexity of individual loss, psi or hint
Inner product, finite-dimensionality or completeness of E
Absolute objective-gap bound, nonnegative gap, distance bound or regret-sum conclusion
Proof compilation, proof-body correctness or source faithfulness
